_comment: Q86 inc.3 — a LIVE read of Rob's primary Google Calendar (rob@aivoicetech.io), taken 2026-08-07 by the build driver through the Google Calendar MCP. It is a SNAPSHOT, not a cache: no OAuth/service-account credential for Calendar exists in .env.local, so no .mjs script in this repo can fetch this itself today. `scripts/calendar-spine.mjs` therefore consumes a snapshot and states its age; the fetcher gap is written up in the increment note. Window is deliberately short (2 weeks) — this is the first live pass and a small window that is verifiably right beats a long one nobody checked.

_pii: Attendee EMAIL ADDRESSES ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT and were never needed. `fromCalendarEvents` reads exactly two things off an attendee: Googles own `self` marker, and the COUNT of everyone else. It never reads an address. Committing the real ones would have put live contacts (a client, Robs brother, a restaurant) into git for no gain — guard:pii caught it on pre-push, which is the guard doing its job. Attendee identity is resolved from the LIVE calendar by person-resolver, never from this file.
